title: Guide:Getting started
qa: I just started Terraria. What should I do with the wood I collect?
Craft a Work Bench and some platforms. If you also get Gel from a Slime, you can make Torches.
How do I use a crafting station?
Place it in the world and stand near it. Keeping the station in your inventory does not satisfy the crafting requirement.
What should I watch out for when entering dark caves early on?
Bring Torches or Glowsticks and watch for Pressure Plates, because they can trigger dangerous traps.
How can I avoid getting trapped when digging a vertical shaft?
Place Ropes or Platforms as you descend so you have a reliable way back up.

title: Guide:Getting started with Hardmode
qa: What activates Hardmode in a normal world?
Defeating the Wall of Flesh for the first time. The world gains new enemies and resources, and Hardmode cannot be disabled.
Which ores are generated by the first three altars smashed in Hardmode?
First Cobalt or Palladium, then Mythril or Orichalcum, and finally Adamantite or Titanium.
What early tool can mine Cobalt or Palladium?
A Molten Pickaxe. The first Hardmode ore can then be used to craft a tool capable of mining the next tier.
What happens if I smash more altars after the first three?
The three-tier cycle repeats, creating more of the same Hardmode ore types selected for that world.

title: Life Crystal
qa: How much maximum health does one Life Crystal add?
It permanently adds 20 maximum health and also restores 20 health when consumed.
How many Life Crystals are needed to go from 100 to 400 maximum health?
15 Life Crystals. Each adds 20 health, for a total increase of 300.
Why can I no longer consume Life Crystals at 400 maximum health?
Life Crystals cannot raise maximum health beyond 400. To go higher, you need Life Fruits.
Where should I look for naturally generated Life Crystals?
They are found in the Underground layer and below, excluding the Underworld and Dungeon, and they are relatively uncommon.

title: Mana Crystal
qa: How do I craft a Mana Crystal?
Combine 5 Fallen Stars by hand; no crafting station is required.
How much maximum mana does one Mana Crystal add?
It permanently increases maximum mana by 20, up to 200 from Mana Crystals.
How many Mana Crystals do I need from the initial 20 mana to reach 200?
9 Mana Crystals.
How many Fallen Stars are needed to maximize mana from the initial value?
45 Fallen Stars: 9 Mana Crystals times 5 Fallen Stars each.

title: Furnace
qa: How do I craft a basic Furnace?
At a Work Bench, combine 20 Stone Blocks, 4 Wood, and 3 Torches.
What is the main purpose of a Furnace?
It is mainly used to smelt ores into bars and to craft certain furniture and materials.
Can a normal Furnace smelt Hellstone?
No. Hellstone requires a Hellforge; the normal Furnace handles earlier ores.
Does the light from a Furnace satisfy the lighting requirement for NPC housing?
No. A Furnace emits light but does not count as a valid housing light source.

title: Plantera
qa: What must I defeat before Plantera's Bulbs begin appearing?
All three mechanical bosses: The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.
How do I summon Plantera after meeting the progression requirement?
Break a Plantera's Bulb in the Underground Jungle. The bulb summons Plantera near you.
Which Plantera drop opens the Jungle Temple?
The Temple Key.
What happens to evil-biome spread after Plantera is defeated?
The spread speed of Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow is reduced by half.

title: Guide Voodoo Doll
qa: Which enemy drops the Guide Voodoo Doll?
The Voodoo Demon in the Underworld drops it guaranteed.
How do I use a Guide Voodoo Doll to summon the Wall of Flesh?
Throw it into lava in the Underworld while the Guide is alive. The doll is destroyed and the Guide dies as the boss is summoned.
Does the Guide have to be near me when I throw the doll into lava?
No. The Guide does not need to be nearby, but must be alive.
What happens if I throw a Guide Voodoo Doll into lava outside the Underworld?
The Guide may die, but the Wall of Flesh will not be summoned. The lava must be in the Underworld.

title: Old Man
qa: Where do I find the Old Man?
At the entrance to the Dungeon.
How do I summon Skeletron through the Old Man?
Talk to him at night and choose Curse. During the day he tells you to return at night.
Is it safe to explore deep inside the Dungeon before defeating Skeletron?
No. Dungeon Guardians can spawn once you descend far enough and usually kill an unprepared player immediately.
What happens to the Old Man after Skeletron is defeated?
He is freed from the curse and can move in as the Clothier if valid housing is available.

title: Mechanical bosses
qa: What are the three mechanical bosses?
The Twins, The Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.
Which items summon the three mechanical bosses?
Mechanical Eye summons The Twins, Mechanical Worm summons The Destroyer, and Mechanical Skull summons Skeletron Prime.
Which soul does each mechanical boss drop?
The Twins drop Souls of Sight, The Destroyer drops Souls of Might, and Skeletron Prime drops Souls of Fright.
At which station are the mechanical boss summon items crafted?
At a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil.

title: Nurse
qa: What conditions are needed for the Nurse to move in?
There must be valid vacant housing, at least one player must have more than 100 maximum health, and the Merchant must be present.
What service does the Nurse provide?
She restores health and removes many debuffs in exchange for coins, with some exceptions.
Can the Nurse remove Potion Sickness?
No. Potion Sickness is one of the debuffs she does not remove.
Why does the Nurse's healing price change?
It depends on factors such as her happiness, world progression, and difficulty, so there is no single fixed price for the entire game.

title: House
qa: How large must valid NPC housing be?
A valid house must contain at least 60 but fewer than 750 total tiles when the surrounding frame is counted.
Do natural Dirt Walls automatically count as valid housing background walls?
No. Unsafe natural walls such as Dirt Walls do not count as valid background walls for housing.
Why should I avoid leaving holes in a house's background walls?
Gaps can allow enemies to spawn inside. Use safe crafted walls, such as Glass Wall, if you want a window-like opening.
Can several town NPCs share one assigned house?
Each town NPC that needs housing requires its own valid house, so build separate valid rooms or houses.

title: NPCs
qa: Which NPC normally appears when a new world begins?
The Guide. Special world seeds can change the initial NPC.
How can I check what recipes use a material?
Show the material to the Guide through his crafting help option to see recipes that use it.
What money requirement allows the Merchant to arrive?
Players must collectively have more than 50 Silver Coins in their inventories, and valid vacant housing is also required.
What do I need for the Demolitionist to move in?
Have an explosive in a player's inventory, have the Merchant present, and provide valid vacant housing.

title: Beds
qa: Which part of a Bed sets the player's spawn point?
Interact with the foot of a Bed that is placed in a valid room.
How do I remove a spawn point that was set with a Bed?
Interact with the foot of that assigned Bed again to return the spawn point to the world's default.
Which part of a Bed is used for sleeping?
The head of the Bed. Sleeping and setting spawn are separate interactions.
Do different Bed styles have different functions?
No. Bed styles mainly differ in appearance; their core functions are the same.

title: Recall Potion
qa: Where does a Recall Potion teleport me?
To your current spawn point.
What advantage does a Recall Potion have over a Magic Mirror in an emergency?
It teleports faster, but one potion is consumed per use.
Where can I find Recall Potions without crafting them?
They can be found in Pots and Chests and may also appear as a rare bonus drop from Slimes.
What is the recipe for a Recall Potion?
Bottled Water, Specular Fish, and Daybloom at a Placed Bottle or compatible alchemy station.

title: Magic Mirrors
qa: Is a Magic Mirror consumed when I teleport home?
No. It has unlimited uses and returns you to your spawn point after its use animation.
Does an Ice Mirror function differently from a Magic Mirror?
No. It is an alternative item with the same teleport function.
Where can I find an Ice Mirror?
In Frozen Chests in the Ice biome.
Which mode gives newly created characters a Magic Mirror?
Journey Mode.

title: Obsidian
qa: How is Obsidian formed?
It forms when Water and Lava come into contact.
Can Lava destroy dropped Obsidian?
No. Obsidian is not destroyed by Lava.
How much Obsidian is needed for an Obsidian Skull, and where is it crafted?
20 Obsidian at a Furnace.
How can I produce a large amount of Obsidian with Water and Lava?
Keep a Water reservoir above Lava and mine the Obsidian layer as it forms so the liquids can continue meeting.
